title: Felix and the Orbit
author: Casper Kavanagh
blurb: Gideon Blackwood, the last human technician on an automated relay station, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
